title: Social Remit domain event envelope
description: Every domain event published to EventBridge or SQS must satisfy this envelope. The payload is validated separately against the schema named by eventType + eventVersion.

eventId.description: Unique per publication attempt of a distinct fact. Consumers deduplicate on this value. Redelivery of the same fact MUST reuse the same eventId.

eventType.description: aggregate.fact, e.g. phone.challenge_issued. Version is carried separately, not in the type.

eventVersion.description: Incremented only for breaking payload changes. Additive optional fields do not bump this.

occurredAt.description: When the fact became true in the producing service, not when it was published.

correlationId.description: Constant for the whole customer-visible interaction. Originates at the BFF.

causationId.description: The eventId or requestId that directly caused this event. Null only for events originating from an inbound request.

subjectId.description: Canonical Social Remit identifier the event is about (sr_customer_id, journeyId, sr_device_id). Never a provider identifier.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context propagated from the originating request.

payload.description: Privacy-minimised. MUST NOT contain: passcodes, OTP codes, biometric data, tokens, full phone numbers, full email addresses, legal name, or provider error text.

forbiddenPayloadKeys.description: CI lint rejects any event payload schema declaring these property names.
